$comment: Round 2 (docs/round-2-contract.md §7): the layout NUMBERS every painter shares where no theme token decides (px unless noted). `windowThreshold` = items past which List and Table window; `windowOverscan` = items rendered beyond each viewport edge; `resizeStep` = percentage points per arrow key on a Resizable handle; `panelMin` = a panel's min (percent) when unset; `resizeHandleHit` = a handle's hit area across its hairline; `fieldIntrinsicWidth` = the max-content width of a text field (Input, Textarea, NumberField, ChipInput: never the browser's `size` default) — picker triggers (Select, DatePicker, DateRangePicker, TimePicker) size to their content; `mediaIntrinsicWidth` = the max-content width of an Image/Video without a width (its min-content is 0); `mediaAspectRatio` = width/height of an Image without `aspectRatio` or a height (Video: its `aspectRatio` default); `treeGuideColumn` = one TreeGuides gutter column (the recipe's `line` width is the STROKE; round 3: 14, the ×4 app indent, the elbow lands on the parent's lead glyph); `treeGuideRadius` = the elbow's corner radius; `treeGuideBridge` = how far the guide verticals overshoot the row's TOP edge (paint only) so a Section's hairline divider never breaks the line. EXP-1259 (packages/domain-contract/fixtures/feedback-states.json + search-list.json): `pendingDelayMs` = how long a `loading` Button waits before it shows the spinner and its `pendingLabel` (a fast action never flashes; presses are refused at once); `skeletonPulseMs` / `skeletonOpacityLow` / `skeletonOpacityHigh` = the placeholder's ONE opacity pulse (low → high → low, ease-in-out), `skeletonReducedOpacity` = its static opacity under reduce motion; `searchListFade` = the bottom fade over a SearchList (or a searchable submenu) while more rows sit below. EXP-1548: `tableColumnMin` = the narrowest a Table column without a `width` gets; a table whose columns need more than its box scrolls horizontally (VAPP-250: 96, three columns fit a 360 pt phone's 296 px with "qualified" badges and "€12,000" cells whole; lower breaks 11-letter words mid-word in a table that scrolls anyway). Generated into every target; src/layout.ts reads it. VAPP-279: `tabStripMaxWidth` = the widest a `strip` Tabs item gets (its title truncates); `tabDragThreshold` = how far a pointer travels on a strip tab before the press becomes a reorder drag; `tabLongPressMs` = how long a touch rests on a strip tab before it drags (a touch that moves first scrolls or presses). Round 8 (docs/round-8-contract.md §1): THE Canvas box = THE Motion box (no number here, the rule every measurer shares): its intrinsic size is `size` [w, h] px; unstyled it is `width: w` + `maxWidth: 100%` + `aspectRatio: w/h` (the drawing's width, shrinking to the parent, its height from the aspect); a style `width` OR `height` wins with the aspect filling the other edge; both = no aspect. No baseline. The Rust core: layout_tree `motion_box` (Motion | Canvas) + measure.rs; TS: src/canvas.ts `canvasBoxStyle` (web/primitives/motion.ts `motionBoxStyle` for Motion); SwiftUI / Compose `SurfaceMeasurer` answer a Canvas leaf's intrinsics with `size`. #EXP-1629: `selectRowPopupWidth` = the popup width of a `row` Select without a `popupWidth` (the IDE's searchable picker popover: its 260 content plus the border, 262); `selectRowPopupOffset` = how far under the row's VALUE its popup hangs (the IDE's popover opens a point under it, 1); `selectRowValueMaxWidth` = the widest a row's value gets before it truncates (the IDE's picker value cap, 240); `selectRowPopupMargin` = how close to the view's edges that popup may go (7). `selectRowDescriptionMaxWidth` = the widest a row's `description` gets before it wraps (the IDE's row hint cap, 460). #EXP-1765: `selectLoadingRows` = the Skeleton rows a `loading` Select's popup shows in place of its options (the IDE picker's placeholder, 3); a `pill` Select's popup (the IDE's searchable picker popover, its 1 px ring OUTSIDE its 260 content) is `selectRowPopupWidth` wide unless `popupWidth` says otherwise, its border box `selectPillPopupOffset` under the pill (3) and starting `selectPillPopupInset` before the pill's aligned edge (1). A Menu item's `preview` (the IDE composer menu's side hover card) sits `menuPreviewOffset` beside its row (10), shows `menuPreviewOpenMs` after the pointer enters the row (150; a keyboard highlight shows it at once) and hides `menuPreviewCloseMs` after the pointer and the highlight left both the row and the preview (80). #EXP-1778: a `button` Select's popup is the IDE's pointer menu (its 1 px ring OUTSIDE its content): it fits its options, at least `selectButtonPopupMinWidth` wide (the menu's 128 content plus the ring) unless `popupWidth`/`popupMinWidth` say otherwise, its border box `selectButtonPopupOffset` under the trigger (the popover's quarter-rem 3.5 less the ring) and `selectPillPopupInset` before its aligned edge. Its rows sit `selectButtonItemGap` apart (2) and hold the check on the CHOSEN row only (the `check` after the item's `gap`; the other rows reserve no slot).
